# Technologický strom

Uzly technologického stromu odemykají položky výdajem **výzkumných bodů** (získávaných z jader — viz [Research](/cs/features/research/) v sekci features). Uzel lze odemknout jen tehdy, když je odemčen jeho **rodič** a je naučeno **enabler rozšíření**. Typy bodů: common, hitech, industrial, newtech, nuimqol, pelistal, thelodica.

## Kategorie

Každá kategorie má vlastní stránku s celým stromem a jednou stránkou na uzel.

| Category | Nodes | Root lines | What it unlocks |

| [ Thelodica (faction) ](/cs/content/techtree/groups/thelodica/) | 87 | 3 | Research for the Thelodica Clan faction: its named weapons and the modules that fight alongside them. |
| [ Common (first set) ](/cs/content/techtree/groups/common1/) | 78 | 4 | The first set of standard (non-faction) modules available to every player. |
| [ PBS structures ](/cs/content/techtree/groups/pbs/) | 84 | 1 | Power base station capsules and construction modules — the buildings of open-world corporate play. |
| [ Industrial ](/cs/content/techtree/groups/indy/) | 67 | 3 | Industrial research: reactor boosters and the modules that keep production lines moving. |
